full_page.content:
1946, August 8.
The following is a faithful transcription of message written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. on - Seraphic Mass Association enrollment card.
Mrs. Marion Stone for Special Inten.
August 8, 1945
God bless you Mrs. Stone - you and yours. Why worry so easily! Is not God watching over us the divine Aut'or of all beautiful solicitude? Rather start now to thank Him for His designs for your future.
"God condecends to use our powers If we don't spoil His plans by ours". Fr. Solanus C.F.M. Cap.
Praised be Jesus Christ
Original in possession of: Mrs. Marion Stone 2557 Somerset Blvd. Troy, Michigan 48084
